description: Source code for the CCalcEngine class, implementing numeric base and bit manipulation functions, including setting radix and width, toggling bits, and calculating maximum digits for number representation.

classes.name: CCalcEngine

methods.name: SetRadixTypeAndNumWidth

methods.name: TryToggleBit
methods.description: Toggles a specific bit in a Rational number, returning true if successful.

methods.name: QuickLog2
methods.description: Calculates the nearest power of two less than or equal to a given number.
